description: This source file is a Java Spring MVC Controller class managing shipping configuration features in an e-commerce administration panel. It handles HTTP requests related to displaying, saving, and updating shipping settings and supported countries for a merchant store.

classes.name: ShippingConfigsController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing shipping configurations in the administration interface.

methods.name: displayShippingConfigs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the current shipping configuration for the merchant store. Retrieves existing configuration or creates a default, then adds it to the model.

methods.name: saveShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update shipping configuration settings sent from the form.

methods.name: pageCountries
methods.description: Handles POST requests to provide a paginated list of countries, indicating whether each is supported for shipping, returning the data as JSON.

methods.name: updateCountry
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the supported status of a country for shipping, modifying the supported countries list accordingly.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the menu context for the administration UI, used internally to configure the active menu items.
